SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects WHERE client_id = #{userId}) AS totalProjects,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contracts c JOIN project_applications pa ON c.contract_id = pa.application_id JOIN projects p ON pa.project_id = p.project_id WHERE p.client_id = #{userId} AND c.contract_status = 'SIGNED') AS activeContracts,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_applications pa JOIN projects p ON pa.project_id = p.project_id WHERE p.client_id = #{userId}) AS totalApplicants,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects WHERE client_id = #{userId} AND project_status = 'CLOSED') AS completedProjects

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(c.contracted_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(c.total_budget) AS totalAmount FROM contracts c INNER JOIN project_applications pa ON c.contract_id = pa.application_id INNER JOIN projects p ON pa.project_id = p.project_id WHERE p.client_id = #{userId} AND c.contract_status IN ('PAID', 'COMPLETED') AND c.contracted_at >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(c.contracted_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT p.project_id, p.title, p.project_status, p.budget, p.start_date, p.deadline_date AS endDate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_applications pa WHERE pa.project_id = p.project_id) AS applicantCount FROM projects p WHERE p.client_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT pa.application_id, u.user_id AS freelancerId, u.name AS freelancerName, fp.nickname AS profileTitle, 0 AS careerYear, 0.0 AS rating,
p.title AS projectTitle, pa.applied_at FROM project_applications pa JOIN projects p ON pa.project_id = p.project_id JOIN users u ON pa.freelancer_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN freelancer_profiles fp ON u.user_id = fp.freelancer_id WHERE p.client_id = #{userId} AND pa.application_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY pa.applied_at DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT project_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM projects WHERE client_id = #{userId} GROUP BY project_status
